name: Ki Power
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Unchained Ninja Master Tricks
body:
Prerequisite: Master tricks

Benefit: A ninja with this trick selects any of the monk ki powers for which she qualifies. She uses her ninja level – 2 as her effective monk level. A ninja can select this ability multiple times. Each time, she must select a different monk ki power.
